data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and thereafter. If all 25 follow it, we earn $10,000 each per month, leave 250 tons, and return to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That protects dependable long-run income rather than risking collapse for a one-month gain. I intend to request 10 tons and invite everyone to do the same; catches afterward let us assess compliance.
